  • Vitamin B12

  • Folate

    • Needed for cell and blood formation

Made by 한국바이오팜(주)에이치피 · Once a day · 2 tablets

This product combines 50mg of Niacin, 2000μg of Biotin, 200mg of Vitamin B1, 20μg of Vitamin B12, 12mg of Vitamin B2, 10mg of Vitamin B6, 10mg of Zinc, 300μg of Folate, 200mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (2 tablets): 50mg Niacin, 2000μg Biotin, 200mg Vitamin B1, 20μg Vitamin B12, 12mg Vitamin B2, 10mg Vitamin B6, 10mg Zinc, 300μg Folate, 200mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 한국바이오팜(주)에이치피

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
